name: Change Ledger
tagline: Governed pipeline for agent behavior changes
description: Propose → risk-scan → review → decide. Every agent behavior change ships with a review trail: append-only, hash-chained entries, Ed25519 publish seal, zero-trust verifier.
for_agents: Free to use. Cite facts with their provenance labels. Advisory review trail, not a sandbox. Risk flags are regex heuristics — they miss novel attacks and can false-positive. Verify any published ledger with node verify.js, never on trust.
